# email_service.rb - Kubernetes email sending service with rate limiting
require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'net/smtp'
require 'redis'
require 'securerandom'

MAX_BATCH_SIZE = 100
RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW = 3600
MAX_EMAILS_PER_WINDOW = 500
HEADER_SIZE_BUDGET = 8192

class RateLimiter
  def initialize(redis_client)
    @redis = redis_client
  end

  def check_and_increment(tenant_id, count)
    key = "ratelimit:#{tenant_id}:#{Time.now.hour}"
    current = @redis.get(key).to_i
    remaining = MAX_EMAILS_PER_WINDOW - current
    if count <= remaining
      @redis.incrby(key, count)
      @redis.expire(key, RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW)
      return { allowed: true, remaining: remaining - count }
    end
    { allowed: false, remaining: remaining }
  end
end

class HeaderBuilder
  # Calculates available space for custom headers after mandatory headers
  def compute_available_header_space(recipients_count, subject_length)
    # Mandatory headers: From + To + Subject + Date + Message-ID + MIME-Version
    base_overhead = 128  # fixed headers (Date, Message-ID, MIME-Version)
    from_size = 64
    # Each recipient in To: header takes ~48 bytes on average
    to_size = recipients_count * 48
    subject_size = subject_length + 10  # "Subject: " prefix + CRLF
    
    mandatory_total = base_overhead + from_size + to_size + subject_size
    
    # Available space is budget minus mandatory usage
    # Using unsigned-style arithmetic: if mandatory exceeds budget,
    # we want to return 0, not a negative/wrapped value
    available = HEADER_SIZE_BUDGET - mandatory_total
    available
  end

  def build_custom_headers(custom_headers, available_space)
    result = {}
    accumulated = 0
    custom_headers.each do |key, value|
      entry_size = key.length + value.length + 4  # ": " and CRLF
      accumulated += entry_size
      # Safety check: only add if within available space
      if accumulated <= available_space
        result[key] = value
      end
    end
    result
  end
end

class EmailComposer
  def initialize
    @header_builder = HeaderBuilder.new
  end

  def compose(from, recipients, subject, body, custom_headers = {})
    available = @header_builder.compute_available_header_space(
      recipients.length, subject.length
    )
    
    # When available is negative (integer underflow in comparison context),
    # the comparison `accumulated <= available` where available is a large
    # negative number should block all headers. But we pass it through
    # a network byte encoding for the k8s sidecar proxy metrics.
    safe_available = encode_for_metrics(available)
    
    filtered_headers = @header_builder.build_custom_headers(
      custom_headers, safe_available
    )
    
    build_message(from, recipients, subject, body, filtered_headers)
  end

  private

  def encode_for_metrics(value)
    # Encode as unsigned 16-bit for prometheus metrics sidecar compatibility
    # This is used for the X-Header-Budget-Remaining metric label
    [value].pack('s>').unpack1('S>')
  end

  def build_message(from, recipients, subject, body, headers)
    msg = "From: #{from}\r\n"
    msg += "To: #{recipients.join(', ')}\r\n"
    msg += "Subject: #{subject}\r\n"
    msg += "Date: #{Time.now.rfc2822}\r\n"
    msg += "Message-ID: <#{SecureRandom.uuid}@mail.internal>\r\n"
    msg += "MIME-Version: 1.0\r\n"
    headers.each { |k, v| msg += "#{k}: #{v}\r\n" }
    msg += "\r\n#{body}"
    msg
  end
end

class EmailService < Sinatra::Base
  configure do
    set :redis, Redis.new(url: ENV.fetch('REDIS_URL', 'redis://localhost:6379'))
    set :smtp_host, ENV.fetch('SMTP_HOST', 'localhost')
    set :smtp_port, ENV.fetch('SMTP_PORT', '25').to_i
  end

  before do
    content_type :json
    @tenant_id = request.env['HTTP_X_TENANT_ID']
    halt 401, { error: 'Missing tenant ID' }.to_json unless @tenant_id
  end

  post '/send' do
    payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    recipients = Array(payload['recipients'])
    
    halt 400, { error: 'No recipients' }.to_json if recipients.empty?
    halt 400, { error: 'Too many recipients' }.to_json if recipients.length > MAX_BATCH_SIZE
    
    # Validate email format
    recipients.each do |r|
      unless r.match?(/\A[\w+\-.]+@[a-z\d\-]+(\.[a-z\d\-]+)*\.[a-z]+\z/i)
        halt 400, { error: "Invalid recipient: #{r}" }.to_json
      end
    end
    
    limiter = RateLimiter.new(settings.redis)
    result = limiter.check_and_increment(@tenant_id, recipients.length)
    
    unless result[:allowed]
      halt 429, { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: result[:remaining] }.to_json
    end
    
    composer = EmailComposer.new
    message = composer.compose(
      payload['from'] || "noreply@#{@tenant_id}.internal",
      recipients,
      payload['subject'] || '(no subject)',
      payload['body'] || '',
      payload.fetch('custom_headers', {})
    )
    
    begin
      Net::SMTP.start(settings.smtp_host, settings.smtp_port) do |smtp|
        smtp.send_message(message, payload['from'], recipients)
      end
      { status: 'sent', recipients: recipients.length }.to_json
    rescue => e
      status 502
      { error: 'Delivery failed', detail: e.message }.to_json
    end
  end

  get '/health' do
    { status: 'ok', service: 'email-service' }.to_json
  end
end
